stories.title: Follow live: Brewers look to hold on to lead late in Game 2 battle
Quinn says 'no one is pleased' after Commanders' botched play fuels fan angst
stories.summary: Commanders coach Dann Quinn explained the breakdown that caused a botched final play in Sunday's overtime tie, saying it's ultimately his responsibility.

stories.title: 49ers' Greenlaw suspended for head-butting helmetless Seahawks LB
stories.summary: 49ers linebacker Dre Greenlaw has been suspended for one game without pay for unsportsmanlike conduct during Sunday's game against the Seahawks.

stories.title: Sarkisian defends Arch, says 'Manning' name leading to outsized criticism
stories.summary: Texas coach Steve Sarkisian defended Arch Manning on Monday following the upset loss to Oklahoma, saying the "Manning" name is leading to greater scrutiny.

stories.title: Packers' Parsons won't be ready to return for game vs. Cowboys
stories.summary: Not only will Micah Parsons not make his season debut this week vs. his old team, but the Packers edge rusher still isn't ready to practice.
